title: Cyanotype preset
description: A ready combination of catalog entries that simple mode starts a project from: the stack part of a cyanotype.yaml plus metadata. Editor support only: the tool validates presets with its own Go code, which also resolves them against the catalog. See the Presets section of docs/DESIGN.md.

id.description: Stable identifier. Must equal the file name without .yaml.

name.description: Display name, such as Next.js + Supabase.

summary.description: One line saying what the preset is good for.

project_type.description: What the preset builds; simple mode offers the presets of the type the user picks.

selections.description: Catalog entry ids, in the order they go into the spec.

i18n_selections.description: Catalog entry ids added, after i18n-rules, when the app is multilingual or will be, such as the i18n library that fits the stack.

commands.description: The project's own commands, as in cyanotype.yaml. Each is optional and on one line.

dev.description: Starts the project for development, such as pnpm dev.

build.description: Builds the project, such as go build ./....

test.description: Runs the tests, such as pnpm test.

lint.description: Runs the linter, such as golangci-lint run.

output.description: Layout of the generated files, as in cyanotype.yaml.

split.description: auto splits only when the main file would exceed max_lines; always and never force it. Defaults to auto.

max_lines.description: Main file length above which auto splits. Defaults to 100.

topic_dir.description: Folder for topic files relative to the project root, with forward slashes. Defaults to docs/agents.
